title: Catastrophic Overfitting is Weight Drift the Training Loss Cannot See
abstract: arXiv:2611.06082v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fast adversarial training (FAT) makes robust training affordable by replacing the multi-step attack with a single-step one, but it suffers from catastrophic overfitting (CO): partway through training, robustness to multi-step attacks collapses to near zero while the single-step attack used for training keeps being repelled. We show that CO is a quiet escape of the weights. Across the event the network's clean behavior quietly improves, and moving from the weights just before CO to those just after it changes the training objective only marginally while destroying most of the robustness. The training objective is therefore nearly blind to the displacement it causes, so it exerts no force to undo it. The exponential moving average (EMA) of the weights, which FAT protocols already maintain, does not accumulate this drift and stays robust through the entire event. translated_title: 灾难性过拟合是训练损失看不见的权重漂移
translated_abstract: 快速对抗训练（FAT）通过用单步攻击替代多步攻击，使鲁棒训练变得经济可行，但它饱受灾难性过拟合（CO）的困扰：在训练进行到中途时，对多步攻击的鲁棒性会崩溃至接近零，而用于训练的单步攻击却持续被成功抵御。我们证明了CO本质上是权重的一次悄然逃逸。在整个事件过程中，网络在干净样本上的行为悄然改善，而从CO发生前一刻的权重移动到CO发生后一刻的权重，只会边际地改变训练目标，却摧毁了绝大部分鲁棒性。因此，训练目标对其所导致的位移几乎是盲目的，因而不会施加任何力量来撤销这一位移。FAT协议本身已经在维护的权重指数移动平均（EMA）并不会累积这种漂移，并能在整个事件期间保持鲁棒。这一观察提示了一种几乎零成本的修复方法：当验证集鲁棒性下降时，……
tldr: 该论文揭示了灾难性过拟合的本质是训练损失几乎无法感知的权重漂移，并提出利用FAT协议中已有的权重指数移动平均（EMA）作为几乎零成本的修复方案。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that catastrophic overfitting is essentially a weight drift that the training loss can barely see, and proposes using the weight exponential moving average (EMA) already maintained in FAT protocols as a nearly free fix.
